claimLedger.claim: Back pain is common in pregnancy and may be supported with activity and movement advice.
claimLedger.limitations: General guidance; it does not exclude obstetric, urinary or neurological causes.

claimLedger.claim: Pregnancy-related pelvic pain can affect movement and may benefit from assessment.
claimLedger.limitations: Pain location alone cannot establish pelvic girdle pain.
